unit_definition_as_provided.definition: X-axis is categorical (genotype: WT, Atxn1-KI, Atxn1-KI;HMGB1); no units apply.

Y-axis values (0–1.5) represent normalized/relative band intensity with WT set to 1, i.e. a dimensionless ratio; caption states 'The band intensity was quantified and is shown in the lower graphs' without giving a numeric unit, consistent with a unitless relative-intensity scale.

explanation.explanation: Categorical genotype groups do not require units.
The quantified band intensity is presented as a relative/normalized ratio to the WT control (dimensionless), so no physical unit is required on this axis.
Panel B consists of immunoelectron micrographs, not a quantitative plot with axes; axis units are not applicable.
Panel C is a western blot image with labeled lanes, not a quantitative plot with axes; axis units are not applicable.
Panel D is a western blot image with labeled treatment conditions, not a quantitative plot with axes; axis units are not applicable.
